MLPerf EDU currently registers **30 workloads** in **23 families** across **10 suites**. Every page in this section is generated from the [workload registry](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/tree/main/mlperf-edu/registry); the registry YAML is the single source of truth for models, datasets, quality targets, and public-result status.

## Agent Systems (`agent`)

Agentic workloads that measure retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, ReAct-style reasoning loops, and code generation as systems benchmarks rather than capability evaluations.

## Distributed Training (`distributed`)

Local multi-process workloads that expose distributed data-parallel behavior (gradient synchronization, communication/computation overlap) without requiring a cluster.

|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
